name: Securities Financing Confirmation V 13
definition: Scope|A securities financing transaction account servicer sends a SecuritiesFinancingConfirmation to an account owner to confirm or advise of the partial or full settlement of the opening or closing leg of a securities financing transaction. ||The account servicer/owner relationship may be:|- a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure managing securities financing transactions on behalf of their participants|- an agent (sub-custodian) managing securities financing transactions on behalf of their global custodian customer, or |- a custodian managing securities financing transactions on behalf of an investment management institution or a broker/dealer.|||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

TransactionIdentificationDetails.name: Transaction Identification Details
TransactionIdentificationDetails.definition: Securities financing transaction identification information, type (repurchase agreement, reverse repurchase agreement, securities lending or securities borrowing) and other parameters.

TradeDetails.name: Trade Details
TradeDetails.definition: Details of the securities financing deal.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

QuantityAndAccountDetails.name: Quantity And Account Details
QuantityAndAccountDetails.definition: Details related to the account and quantity involved in the transaction.

SecuritiesFinancingDetails.name: Securities Financing Details
SecuritiesFinancingDetails.definition: Details of the closing of the securities financing transaction.

StandingSettlementInstructionDetails.name: Standing Settlement Instruction Details
StandingSettlementInstructionDetails.definition: Specifies what settlement standing instruction database is to be used to derive the settlement parties involved in the transaction.

SettlementParameters.name: Settlement Parameters
SettlementParameters.definition: Parameters which explicitly state the conditions that must be fulfilled before a particular transaction of a financial instrument can be settled. These parameters are defined by the instructing party in compliance with settlement rules in the market the transaction will settle in.

DeliveringSettlementParties.name: Delivering Settlement Parties
DeliveringSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of delivering settlement parties.

ReceivingSettlementParties.name: Receiving Settlement Parties
ReceivingSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of receiving settlement parties.

CashParties.name: Cash Parties
CashParties.definition: Cash parties involved in the transaction if different from the securities settlement parties.

SettledAmount.name: Settled Amount
SettledAmount.definition: Amount effectively settled and which will be credited to/debited from the account owner's cash account. It may differ from the instructed settlement amount based on market tolerance level.

OtherAmounts.name: Other Amounts
OtherAmounts.definition: Other amounts than the settlement amount.

DigitalPaymentSettlement.name: Digital Payment Settlement
DigitalPaymentSettlement.definition: Total quantity  of digital asset to be paid or received in exchange for the securities token; or the network fee.

OtherBusinessParties.name: Other Business Parties
OtherBusinessParties.definition: Other business parties relevant to the transaction.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

BuyerSSIRule.definition: If standing settlement instruction applies and the confirmation is on a delivery, then Buyer must be present.

SellerSSIRule.definition: If standing settlement instruction applies and the confirmation is on a receive, then Seller must be present.

DeliveringDepositoryAndParty1Rule.definition: If the confirmation is on a receive and no standing settlement instruction applies, then DeliveringDepository and Party1 must be present.

ReceivingDepositoryAndParty1Rule.definition: If the confirmation is on a delivery and no standing settlement instruction applies, then ReceivingDepository and Party1 must be present.

SettledAmountRule.definition: If the instruction is against payment, then SettledAmount must be present.
